newsitem.title: USA: National Energy has Oklahoma gas finds.
newsitem.headline: National Energy has Oklahoma gas finds.

text.p: National Energy Group Inc said it is producing two recent Oklahoma completions.

The Powers 34-2, drilled on acreage in Custer County, is producing about 3.5 million cubic feet per day on an 8/64 choke with a flowing tubing pressure of 4,200 pounds per square inch. The company is the operator of the well and has a 77 percent working interest.

National Energy said it plans to produce the Atoka zone naturally until the bottom hole pressure is compatible with an "impressive" Red Fork sand which is currently behind pipe. The Atoka will then be stimulated, the Red Fork completed, and the two zones produced simultaneously.

National Energy said the Verna Roberts 17-3, drilled in Ellis County, was completed in the Douglas sand through perforations from 7,316 to 7,416 feet. Current production rates are about 1.3 million cubic feed daily on a 17/64 choke.
